scientific_integrity: An analytic upper and matching lower proof establish the infinite family; finite exact tests are diagnostic only. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected unweighted simple graphs; real scalar globally Lipschitz superposition and rooted anchored l1 graph variation. Unweighted maximum cuts govern the sharp two-input modulus; not a statement for unanchored or quadratic Sobolev norms. Historical novelty has residual unindexed-literature risk.
title: Sharp graph-cut formula for the anchored-variation Lipschitz modulus of scalar superposition
